65:1: O Prophet! When you divorce women, divorce them within their iddahs and count the iddah. Fear your Rabb Allah. Do not drive them out of their houses, nor shall they leave, except in the case of their committing an open indecency. These are the limits of Allah. Whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has truly wronged himself. You do not know, perhaps Allah will bring about a matter after this.
65:2: When they reach their terms, either retain them in a proper manner or separate from them in a proper manner, and take as witnesses two persons of justice from among you. Perform the testimony for Allah. This is that which is advised to whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day. Whoever fears Allah, He provides a way out for him.
65:3: And He provides for him from where he does not expect. Whoever puts his trust in Allah, He is sufficient for him. Undoubtedly, Allah fulfills His command. Allah has appointed a measure for everything.
65:4: Those of your women who have ceased from menstruation (if you doubt), their iddah is three months, and those who have not yet menstruated (are so as well). As for those who are pregnant, their term is that they deliver their burdens. Whoever fears Allah, He gives him ease in his affair.
65:5: This is the command of Allah, He has sent it down to you. Whoever fears Allah, He covers his evil deeds and magnifies the reward for him.
65:6: House them where you reside, as much as your means allow, and do not harm them in order to put them into distress. If they are pregnant, give them their maintenance until they deliver. If they suckle for you, give them their wages. Agree among yourselves in a proper manner. If you experience difficulty, then another woman will suckle for him.
65:7: Let the possessor of abundance spend from his abundance, and let the one whose provision is restricted spend from what Allah has given him; Allah burdens no soul except with what He has given it; Allah makes ease after hardship.
65:8: How many a town rebelled against the command of its Rabb and His messengers, so We called them to a severe account and punished them with an unseen punishment.
65:9: They tasted the evil outcome of their affair, and the end of their affair was loss.
65:10: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. O possessors of intellect who believe, fear Allah. Allah has sent down to you a dhikr.
65:11: A messenger who recites to you the clear verses of Allah, so that he may bring those who believe and do righteous deeds out of darkness into light. Whoever believes in Allah and does righteous deeds, He admits him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, they will abide therein forever. Allah has truly granted him a good provision.
65:12: Allah is the One Who created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them; the command descends between them, so that you may know that Allah is capable of all things and that Allah has encompassed everything in knowledge.
